item.title: Public Trust in Cancer Info Varies by Political Identity
item.description: How much does political ideology affect Americans’ trust in information from cancer scientists? A recent study found overall confidence to be high but varied by ideology.

item.title: Fate of Bone Marrow Transplant Unit Rests on Sale
item.description: Rhode Island’s only bone marrow transplant and CAR-T unit may close, forcing blood cancer patients to seek lifesaving care out of state.

item.title: Manali Bhave, MD
item.description: Manali Bhave, MD, is a breast oncologist at the Glenn Family Breast Center at Winship Cancer Institute and is an associate professor in the Department of Hematology and Medical Oncology at Emory University School of Medicine.

item.title: Erin Frances Cobain, MD
item.description: Erin Frances Cobain, MD, is a clinical associate professor of internal medicine at the University of Michigan. She also serves as codirector of the Breast Cancer Clinical Research Team at the Rogel Cancer Center.

item.title: Stephanie Graff, MD
item.description: Stephanie L. Graff, MD, is the director of breast oncology at the Brown Health Cancer Institute and associate director of global oncology and policy for the Legorreta Cancer Center at Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island.

item.title: Perioperative Management of Early NSCLC
item.description: Register now for an interactive case-based discussion on perioperative management of stage Ib-III non-small cell lung cancer lacking targetable mutations. The discussion will be moderated by Erin Gillaspie, MD, MPH, and panelists include Omar Abughanimeh, MBBS, and Mark Stavas, MD.

item.description: Success! You’re registered for the case-based discussion on Perioperative Management of Early NSCLC on March 5, 2026 at 6:00 pm CT.

item.title: Bispecific Combo Doubles Overall Survival in DLBCL
item.description: New STARGLO trial data show that patients with relapsed or refractory DLBCL ineligible for transplant had improved survival with glofitamab plus chemo compared with rituximab plus chemo.

item.title: Alexander I. Spira, MD, PhD
item.description: Alexander I. Spira, MD, PhD, is codirector of the Virginia Cancer Specialists Research Institute and Phase 1 Trial Program in Fairfax, Virginia. Dr. Spira is cochair of the Thoracic Oncology Committee and chair of the Research Executive Committee for US Oncology.
